description: An embedded native YAML Bases definition evaluates supported filters, formulas, sorting and grouping while retaining source and reporting unsupported formulas.
source:
# 🧭 Embedded task view

~~~base
filters:
  and:
    - status == "open"
    - priority >= 2
formulas:
  sourcePath: file.path
  unsupportedDate: date(today)
views:
  - type: table
    name: Open tasks
    groupBy: team
    order:
      - priority
    unknownView: keep-view-field
unknownRoot:
  keep: root-field
~~~
